dct_creator_sm: Philippe Archambault (Université Laval, Québec-Océan, Biology Department, Laval University).
dct_description_sm: The purpose is therefore to synthesize all available offshore data sets (> 30 m depth) over 1973-2012 on macrobenthos taxa richness and density in the southeastern Beaufort Sea and Amundsen Gulf regions and produce regional-scale predictive models for richness, density (univariate biodiversity metrics) and communities (multivariate community composition) based on environmental variables sampled at the time of faunal collection.
dct_title_s: Predictive models of macrobenthos patterns in the southeastern Beaufort Sea and Amundsen Gulf
